#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class TaskB {
public:
    void solve(int n, int m) {
        if (n > m) swap(n, m);
        long long V = (long long)n * m;

        if (V < 100) {
            int v = (int)V;
            vector<vector<int>> g(v);
            for (int i = 0; i < v; i++) {
                int r1 = i / m;
                int c1 = i % m;
                if (((r1 + c1) & 1) == 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < v; j++) {
                        int r2 = j / m;
                        int c2 = j % m;
                        if (abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2) == 3) {
                            g[i].push_back(j);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            int pairs = hopcroftKarp(g, m);
            cout << (pairs * 2) << endl;
        } else {
            long long res;
            if (n == 1) {
                res = m / 6 * 6 + (m % 6 == 4 ? 2 : 0) + (m % 6 == 5 ? 4 : 0);
            } else {
                res = V;
                res -= res % 2;
            }
            cout << res << endl;
        }
    }

    static int hopcroftKarp(vector<vector<int>>& g, int cols) {
        int n = g.size();
        vector<int> pairU(n, -1);
        vector<int> pairV(n, -1);
        vector<int> dist(n);
        const int INF = INT_MAX;
        int matching = 0;

        while (bfs(g, cols, pairU, pairV, dist, INF)) {
            for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                int r = u / cols;
                int c = u % cols;
                if (((r + c) & 1) == 0 && pairU[u] == -1 && dfs(u, g, pairU, pairV, dist, INF)) {
                    matching++;
                }
            }
        }
        return matching;
    }

    static bool bfs(vector<vector<int>>& g, int cols, vector<int>& pairU, vector<int>& pairV, vector<int>& dist, int INF) {
        queue<int> q;
        for (int u = 0; u < (int)g.size(); u++) {
            int r = u / cols;
            int c = u % cols;
            if (((r + c) & 1) == 0 && pairU[u] == -1) {
                dist[u] = 0;
                q.push(u);
            } else {
                dist[u] = INF;
            }
        }
        bool found = false;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int v : g[u]) {
                if (pairV[v] == -1) {
                    found = true;
                } else if (dist[pairV[v]] == INF) {
                    dist[pairV[v]] = dist[u] + 1;
                    q.push(pairV[v]);
                }
            }
        }
        return found;
    }

    static bool dfs(int u, vector<vector<int>>& g, vector<int>& pairU, vector<int>& pairV, vector<int>& dist, int INF) {
        for (int v : g[u]) {
            if (pairV[v] == -1 || (dist[pairV[v]] == dist[u] + 1 && dfs(pairV[v], g, pairU, pairV, dist, INF))) {
                pairU[u] = v;
                pairV[v] = u;
                return true;
            }
        }
        dist[u] = INF;
        return false;
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    TaskB solver;
    solver.solve(n, m);
    return 0;
}
